description: This file contains C++ code for managing JavaScript bridge objects within a WebKit-based browser environment, including JavaScript source strings, message handling, and bridge object creation functions.

methods.name: CallBridge
methods.description: Handles decoding a base64 payload, validating UTF-8, and executing a JavaScript script in the WebKit context.

methods.name: OnBridgeQuery
methods.description: Encodes a string payload in base64 and sends a message to the WebKit page.

methods.name: OnCreateBridgeObject
methods.description: Creates a JavaScript object with a function property for message handling.

methods.name: InjectJS
methods.description: Injects JavaScript code into the WebKit frame to set up the service manager and bridge object.

methods.name: HandleMessageToPage
methods.description: Routes messages based on message name to appropriate JavaScript bridge functions.
